all_match_excluding_provenance_gating_no: excludes only the 'prov' checks: recorded decision vs the verifier's full-precedence decision and the emptiness of recorded invalid/incomplete reasons (these fail when the verifier derives INVALID/INCOMPLETE reasons from run provenance, e.g. a declared dry run with 2 rounds, that the runner did not list)
analysis_inputs: verifier-recomputed audit arrays for all models

B.aggregates_verifiable_all_models_have_.note: aggregate comparisons below treat such models as zero-ECA/no-failure and are NOT verifiable

recorded_meta.rng: numpy PCG64 Generator, integers(0,R,size=(n_boot,R)) shared across all contrasts

B.bootstrap.per_replicate_D_sha256.verifier_summation: diff.mean(axis=(models,t)) with diff shaped (15 models, 2 t, 100 R)

failure_exact.description: exact rational risk>alpha and LCB>acceptance comparisons

failure_alt_no_lcbpos.description: clause (i) without 'common LCB > 0' in the deployable set

failure_alt_ii_deployable_only.description: clause (ii) restricted to deployable risk-passing candidates

dispatch_sensitivity.status: not applicable: CPU has no AVX512F, so native dispatch equals the no-avx512 dispatch

interpretation_notes: Draw seed parts are [split (int), domain NAME (str), replicate (int)], as in the frozen local_training seed; the domain index reading gives different streams.
Budget B uses the first B/J entries of the single 256-long audit_indices stream (nested prefixes), drawn over the identity-sorted audit list of that domain.
Candidate family: proposals() on the 4 proposal domains concatenated in protocol domain order (pooling order does not change the result).
certify() is called unbatched on (12,J) arrays with alpha/delta_r/delta_c from PROTOCOL.json; choose() per replicate; ECA = common_acceptance_lcb[chosen], 0 on refusal.

Truth: counts_for_draws over arange(frame) per domain after all selections; worst risk = max over the J vertices of Lambda_t of sum(v*m)/sum(v*a) (0 if the denominator is 0); worst acceptance = min over vertices of sum(v*a).

Joint failure = (i) any candidate with passed & eligible & LCB>0 and worst risk > alpha, OR (ii) any of the 12 candidates with LCB > worst acceptance (method independent); float comparisons as in FIXED_INTERPRETATIONS. Exact-rational and two alternative readings are reported under sensitivity.

D[a,k,r] = mean over the 15 models of architecture a and both t of (V1 - control) at B=512; delta_hat = mean_r D; bootstrap idx = Generator(PCG64(2026091601)).integers(0,100,(20000,100)) shared by all 16 contrasts; boot = D[idx].mean(1); CI = quantile(boot,[.05/32, 1-.05/32], linear); boot_sd ddof=1.
Validity p = P(Bin(100,.10) >= c) = binom.sf(c-1,100,.10) (1 for c=0); flag if p <= .05/1260.
Gates: INVALID > INCOMPLETE > HOLD_VALIDITY > KILL > CONFIRM > HOLD; KILL = any fixed ci_upper<=0 or both g_a<.002; CONFIRM = both g_a>=.01 and all 14 fixed ci_lower>0.

Verifier-derived INVALID reasons: declared dry-run/wiring-check/rounds-override provenance, synthetic logits flag, hash-linkage failures, frame/label/role problems, and any mismatch between recorded and recomputed audit or analysis. INCOMPLETE: missing models/files, completed_rounds != 30, RUN_STATE errors, denominator shortfalls.

numpy float64 exp/log/log1p kernels differ between AVX512 and non-AVX512 dispatch; this verifier disables AVX512 dispatch by default (matches an AVX2-only host) and cross-checks native dispatch when the CPU has AVX512.

numpy_dispatch.NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES: AVX512F AVX512CD AVX512_KNL AVX512_KNM AVX512_SKX AVX512_CLX AVX512_CNL AVX512_ICL
